nodes.label: NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM Module-Lattice Key Encapsulation Standard
nodes.description: Finalized NIST post-quantum cryptographic standard defining key encapsulation mechanisms derived from the Kyber algorithm, securing key exchange against quantum cryptanalysis.

nodes.label: DMTF SPDM 1.3 Security Protocol and Data Model Specification
nodes.description: Standardized hardware authentication and key exchange protocol providing device attestation, session key establishment, and secure memory measurements over PCIe and CXL architectures.

nodes.label: Rabin-Karp Rolling Hash String Matching & Content Deduplication Algorithm
nodes.description: Sub-string search and chunking algorithm utilizing polynomial rolling hash functions to enable fast content-defined chunking for data deduplication in distributed graph storage.

nodes.label: W3C Terse RDF Triple Language (Turtle) Syntax Specification
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation specifying a compact, human-readable textual format for expressing RDF graph statements, supporting URIs, blank nodes, and datatyped literals.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Python Suite for Arabic Natural Language Processing
nodes.description: Open-source toolkit providing utilities for Arabic morphological disambiguation, dialect identification, named entity recognition, and sentiment analysis.
